prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A modern, sunlit living room interior with a sophisticated, minimalist aesthetic. The scene is anchored by a sleek, tan leather sofa with clean lines, accented by a single muted green throw pillow. In front of the sofa sits a low, round coffee table in light wood, holding a small, delicate plant. To the right, a contemporary white lounge chair with a matching ottoman faces the sofa, creating a cozy conversational area atop a plush, cream-colored rug.

The background features a deep, charcoal-gray accent wall adorned with a curated arrangement of abstract, geometric art pieces in neutral tones—beige, white, and soft gray—adding visual interest and depth. A long, white sideboard runs beneath the artwork, topped with minimalist decor and a small potted plant. Overhead, two modern pendant lights with spherical white shades hang at different heights, casting a soft, ambient glow.

To the left, the open-plan space reveals a glimpse of a kitchen with classic white cabinetry and a built-in oven, partially separated by a black metal and wood shelving unit displaying books and decorative objects. A mid-century modern floor lamp with a white dome shade stands beside the sofa, contributing to the warm, inviting atmosphere.

The color palette is harmonious and understated, dominated by earthy neutrals, soft whites, and subtle green accents. Natural light streams in from an unseen window, creating gentle shadows and highlighting the textures of the furniture and decor. The overall composition is balanced and airy, with a cinematic, wide-angle perspective that emphasizes the spaciousness and refined elegance of the room.
